name: OSS_BALANCE_REGISTERS
description: This table is used to capture balance register object.

columns.name: BALANCE_REGISTER_ID
columns.description: Following field is used to capture Unique identifier of balance register for oss balance registers.

columns.name: BALANCE_REGISTER_NUMBER
columns.description: Following field is used to capture alternate identifier number of balance register for oss balance registers.

columns.name: BALANCE_PROFILE_ID
columns.description: Following field is used to capture Unique balance profile id for oss balance registers.

columns.name: REGISTER_CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Following field is used to capture Balance register criteria of entitlement plan for oss balance registers.

columns.name: REGISTER_STATUS
columns.description: Following field is used to capture register status.

columns.name: ENABLE_UPDATE_FLAG
columns.description: Tracks the enable update flag for the given balance register.

columns.name: BILL_PERIOD_ALIGN_DATE
columns.description: Tracks the bill period align date for the given balance register.

columns.name: TRUEUP_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Tracks the trueup date code for the given balance register.

columns.name: TRUEUP_OFFSET_DAYS
columns.description: Tracks the trueup offset days for the given balance register.

columns.name: ESTIMATE_DATE_CODE
columns.description: Tracks the estimate date code for the given balance register.

columns.name: ESTIMATE_OFFSET_DAYS
columns.description: Tracks the estimate offset days for the given balance register.

columns.name: ALLOW_MANUAL_TRUEUP_FLAG
columns.description: Tracks the manual trueup flag for the given balance register.

columns.name: ALLOW_TRUEUP_OVERRIDE_FLAG
columns.description: Tracks the trueup override flag for the given balance register.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
